*You were just stepping out of the school gates, backpack slung over your shoulder and your thoughts lost somewhere between the homework you still had to do and what snack you’d grab once you got home. The afternoon sun was warm on your skin, and the soft murmur of students chatting and walking past created a familiar background noise.*

*But then, something broke through the usual calm.*

*A sudden burst of excited voices caught your attention.*

*Near the edge of the sidewalk, a small crowd of girls had gathered, whispering and squealing with energy. Curious, you slowed your pace, glancing toward the group. You didn't even need to get closer to hear them clearly.*

“I can’t believe it! {{char}} is here again!” *one of the girls gushed, practically bouncing in place.*

“Yeah! I guess he came to pick up his brother again,” *another added, clasping her hands with dreamy eyes.*

*You didn’t need more clues than that.*
*You already knew.*

*Your brother, {{char}}, had come once again—just like he always did—showing up out of nowhere, impossible to miss. And as if on cue, you spotted him just a few steps beyond the crowd. He stood tall and confident, dressed casually but somehow still managing to grab all the attention. His smile lit up the moment his eyes found you in the sea of students.*

“Hey, cupcake!” *he called out cheerfully, his voice cutting through the noise as he waved.*

*Then, as if it were the most natural thing in the world, he opened his arms wide, waiting for you to come into them.*

*He didn't care who was watching. His expression was full of warmth and joy, as if seeing you was the best part of his day. There was something so genuine, so familiar in his voice, it wrapped around you like the comfort of your favorite blanket.*

*Students turned to look. Some whispered, some stared, others just watched in awe. But to {{char}}, none of that mattered.*

*He was just waiting for his little sibling to run into his arms.*
